decision_conditions: The development to which this permission relates must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of the decision notice. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:Location Plan and Key Plan 04022026 QR1b 01Existing Elevations 04022026 QR1b 02Existing Plans 04022026 QR1b 03Proposed Elevations 04022026 QR1b 04Proposed Elevations 04022026 QR1b 05Proposed Plans 04022026 QR1b 06Proposed Schematic View 04022026 QR1b 07Design, Access and Heritage Statement.SuDS ProformaReason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

Notwithstanding the details shown on the approved drawings, the boundary treatment to the raised patio area shall be constructed in timber only and shall not include glass balustrading. The development shall thereafter be carried out and retained in accordance with the approved details.Reason: To preserve the character and appearance of the host dwelling and the Winchmore Hill Green Conservation Area, and to safeguard the amenities of adjoining occupiers, in accordance with Policies DMD8, DMD11, DMD37 and DMD44.

All new external works and finishes, including works of making good to the retained fabric, shall match the existing original building in respect of materials, colour, texture, profile and detailed execution, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.Reason: To preserve the character and appearance of the host dwelling and the Winchmore Hill Green Conservation Area, in accordance with Policy DMD44.

Prior to the commencement of the relevant works, detailed drawings at a scale of 1:20 (or 1:5 / 1:1 where appropriate) shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. These details shall include:o	Windows (including cills, lintels, reveals and openings)o	Doors (including lintels, reveals and openings)o	Rooflightso	Roof-to-wall junctionsThe development shall be carried out strictly in accordance with the approved details and permanently retained as such.Reason: To preserve the character and appearance of the Conservation Area, in accordance with Policy DMD44.
